name: Noah
preview: Sarah: That's great, Noah. Drop it at UPS whenever suits, write Shop···· on the box, and we'll take it from there. The B.04 goes out as soon as the unit lands in C

messages.text: Where is my order? Order #····, email (email hidden)
Used the store-orders skill
Used the customer-care skill
Used the store-orders skill

Noah, that number doesn't match anything on our side. On your email I see two orders, and both have been delivered.

Shop····, the three Bitaxe Gamma 602s, delivered September 26. Shop····, the NerdQaxe++, delivered July 9.

Is ···· from a newer order you placed, or a confirmation code from somewhere else? If you placed something new, tell me the email you used and I'll track it down.
My miner is not working anymore
Used route to tech
I'll let our technical specialist take this one.
A led flashes about every second on the face of the board under the screen

I'm back on the order side, Noah, Hal's looked at it.

Short version: that blown fuse and a board that won't come up is a hardware fault, and it's on Shop····, your NerdQaxe++. Hal has written it up as defective and the return is with the team for approval now. They'll confirm by email shortly, and once it's approved I'll have your prepaid return label and the next step for you right here.

Keep it unplugged until then, and hold onto those photos.
Perfect, thanks. Do I still need to send a few pictures?

Yes, please send them if you can, it only helps. One photo of the board around the fuse and power input, and one of the serial number label. Post them here and they go on the file with the return.

If the photos are awkward to get, don't worry, Hal has enough to go on. The review is already running either way.
(The customer sent this photo without a message.)

That's the one, thanks. Serial (number hidden), NerdQaxe++ 6T, 12V XT30. I've put it on the file with Shop····.

If you can still get one of the fuse and power input side, send it over, but this covers the main thing.
(The customer sent this photo without a message.)

Got it, that's the fuse position F1 and the XT30 input, and nothing looks scorched from here. Both photos are on the file with the return.

That's everything we need from you for now. Keep it unplugged, and you'll get the confirmation on the return by email shortly, with the prepaid label and what to write on the box.
(The customer sent this photo without a message.)

Clear shot of the serial, thanks. That's all three on the file now.

Nothing else needed from you. Leave it unplugged, and the return confirmation with the label comes to (email hidden)
(The customer sent this photo without a message.)

That one's on the file too, good clear view of F1 and the input side.

You're all set, Noah. Nothing more to send. Keep the unit unplugged, and watch your inbox for the return confirmation and the prepaid label.
Thanks, hope to get back hashing soon.

Same here, and you've still got the three Gammas running in the meantime.

One thing I'm curious about, if you don't mind: the fuse blew on you, so you already had a spare 20A to hand. Were you running the NerdQaxe++ off the Mean Well that came with it, or your own 12V supply?
The meanwell that came with the unit

Good to know, that's worth having on the file, so I've noted it with the rest.

Hang on to that Mean Well for now, don't send it unless the label instructions ask for it. The return confirmation comes by email, and I'm here if anything else comes up.
Yes the other three 602 are hashing away, one even hit a bsv block for me in the first three days

A block inside three days on a Gamma 602 is a proper bit of luck. You mentioned that back in September too, nice to hear they're still all three going.

If you're not in it already, come share it in our Discord, plenty of people solo mining on the same boards: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf

That is awesome, I really appreciate you guys taking care of that even
though it was just past the warranty. I'll get that boxed up and dropped
off at UPS. Thanks again for the help! Can't wait to get the 6th back in
the fleet!
